history.text: Hi, this is Austin, a virtual health insurance advisor with Darwix Health. This call is recorded for quality and compliance purposes. Is it okay if we continue?
Yes, that's fine.
Thank you. How can I help you today? I can answer questions about our health plans, or check which plan might fit you.
Hi, I am looking for health insurance for me and my wife.
Ask whether the customer wants a family health insurance plan.
Happy to help with that. I'll ask a few quick questions to see which plans might fit. May I ask how old you are?
I am 42 years old.
Which state do you live in?
I live in Texas
How many people would need coverage, including you?
Just two of us.
Does anyone who would be covered use tobacco?
No, neither of us.
Do you, or anyone who would be covered, have any current medical conditions? You're welcome to skip this one.
No.
Do you have any health insurance right now?
No.
What's the best time for a licensed advisor to call you back with a quote?
Weekend evenings after 6.
And do I have your permission for Darwix Health to contact you about your quote?
That's fine.
And do I have your permission for Darwix Health to contact you about your quote?
Yes.

Thank you, that's everything I need. Based on what you've told me, you may be a fit for Essential Care or Family Shield. A licensed advisor will call you with a personalized quote. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's all. Thanks.
Thank you for calling Darwix Health. Have a great day!

CRM summary: Outcome: qualified. Age and state match at least one plan and the caller consented to contact. Possible plans: Essential Care, Family Shield. Details: age=42; state=Texas; household size=2; tobacco use=no; medical conditions=none; current insurance=none; callback time=Weekend evenings after 6.; consent to contact=yes.
